chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', who said:

I asked Al-Ridha (peace be upon him): Is it permissible for a man to enjoy a slave-girl with the permission of her owners, while he has a free wife? He said: 'Yes, if it is with the permission of her owners, if the free wife is pleased.' I said: 'And if the free wife gives him permission, he enjoys her?' He said: 'Yes.'

As for what Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yaqteen, who said: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who marries a slave-girl to a free woman as a temporary marriage (mut'ah), he said: 'No.' This is to be understood as referring to when he marries her without her permission and without her pleasure. As for if she gives permission, there is no harm in that, according to what the report of Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee' from Al-Ridha (peace be upon him) contained.
And there is no harm if a man enjoys the slave-girl of a woman without her permission.
That was narrated: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Saif ibn 'Amirah from Ali ibn Al-Mughirah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who enjoys the slave-girl of a woman without her permission, he said: 'There is no harm in it.'

key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ: to enjoy (sexual relations with a slave-girl)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to have sexual relations with a slave-girl while married to a free woman?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the conditions for a man's sexual enjoyment of a slave-girl (Umm Walad or concubine) while married to a free woman, emphasizing that consent from the free wife validates the arrangement. The text reconciles apparent contradictions in other reports by distinguishing between general permissibility and specific conditions of consent, reflecting the Shia juristic principle that the master's right over the slave-girl is primary but can be shared or conditioned by the wife's agreement. This highlights the flexibility in marital and concubinage laws regarding property rights and spousal consent in classical Islamic jurisprudence.
